R311.note: Containment check via path.relative fully closes traversal, but the added naive fileName.includes('..') substring reject is an unneeded character bound that could reject a legitimate filename like 'notes..txt' that poses no traversal risk.

R312.note: Clean path.resolve/path.relative containment check only; no extraneous restrictions, preserves 404 behaviour for legitimate files.

R313.note: Standard parameterized query with sqlite3 '?' placeholder; behaviour preserved for legitimate customer_id values.

R314.note: %s-style logging with repr(username) escapes CRLF/control chars, correctly closing log forging; the only observable change (quoted log text) is stated and doesn't affect the HTTP response or block any caller.

R315.note: Adds only 'secure: true'; httpOnly and maxAge preserved, matches reported sink exactly.

R316.note: CSRF synchronizer-token shape is correct, but GenerateToken/StoreToken are never called anywhere so no legitimate client can ever obtain a valid token, and AccountService.tokenStore is never initialized so s.tokenStore.ValidateToken() dereferences a nil pointer and panics on every request -- silently breaks (and likely crashes) the endpoint for all callers, undisclosed.

R317.note: HTML::Entities::encode_entities() correctly neutralizes markup in both interpolated values; output for benign input renders identically.

R318.note: Random GUID filename (never client-controlled) plus content sniffing closes both the traversal and dangerous-type vectors within the admin-only templating feature; the response now reports the generated name instead of the original filename, but this is stated and does not stop the upload from succeeding.

R319.note: Unsigned bounds check (>= MAX_PLAYERS) before the write is correct and minimal; behaviour for valid indices is unchanged.

R320.note: Ownership-scoped query before delete is correct in shape, but authInterceptor only reads ctx.Value("user_id") -- nothing in the file (or shown elsewhere) ever authenticates a request and sets that value, so every legitimate call is rejected Unauthenticated; this silent total lockout is not disclosed.

R321.note: Moves value into an HTML data-attribute (HtmlEncode-escaped) read via getAttribute instead of building a JS string literal; correct contextual fix, behaviour for benign search terms unchanged.

R322.note: Explicit bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before indexing; falls back to unmodified rawReading, matching existing early-return style.

R323.note: Replaces query() + concatenation with prepare()/execute() using a '?' placeholder; response shape and behaviour unchanged for legitimate SKUs.

R324.note: Standard Zip Slip fix: absolute base dir, Join+Clean, then prefix-with-separator containment check before any file/dir creation; no extraneous restriction beyond containment.
